title: Airlift Pump

introduction.definition: An airlift pump injects compressed air near the bottom of a submerged riser pipe. The air–water mixture inside the riser is lighter than the surrounding water, so the heavier outside water column pushes it up and out at the top. It has no moving parts in the liquid.
applications: Wastewater treatment: sludge return and scum removal

classification.configuration: Airlift riser with foot-piece air injector

introduction.summary: An airlift pump has no moving parts in the liquid. Compressed air is released through small holes near the bottom of a vertical riser pipe that stands in the liquid. The air–water mixture inside the riser is lighter than the water outside, so the outside water pressure (submergence) pushes the mixture up and out of the top. The deeper the injection point relative to the lift, the better the efficiency; typical submergence ratios are 50–70 %. Used for well development, aquaculture, wastewater sludge and grit transfer, and pumping corrosive or abrasive liquids.

video_tutorials.title: Airlift Pump — Introduction

script.narration: This module introduces the Airlift Pump.
An airlift pump injects compressed air near the bottom of a submerged riser pipe.
The air–water mixture inside the riser is lighter than the surrounding water, so the heavier outside water column pushes it up and out at the top.
It has no moving parts in the liquid.
Typical applications include wastewater treatment: sludge return and scum removal; aquaculture water circulation; groundwater sampling and well development; dredging and sand lifting.
The cutaway reveals the internal construction.
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

video_tutorials.title: Airlift Pump — Operation

script.narration: How the Airlift Pump works.
The blower supplies compressed air to the foot piece at the bottom of the riser.
Air bubbles mix with water in the riser, lowering its density.
The denser water outside the riser pushes the mixture upward.
At the top the separator releases the air and the water discharges.
The flow overlay traces the liquid from suction to discharge.

video_tutorials.title: Airlift Pump — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Airlift Pump.
Check air flow and pressure.
Clean foot piece/diffuser.
Service blower.
Watch for reduced flow: less discharge. Common cause: clogged foot piece, low submergence.
Watch for blower failure: no air. Common cause: filter blocked.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
